mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, the weather is clear at 65 degrees at City Hall, with an air quality index of 54, which is in the moderate range.

The Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan, a roadmap for the city's future that focuses on housing and sustainability. Additionally, the city is continuing its regular engineering service reports handled by AECOM.

There is plenty to do today, starting with the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Square, live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Puppets in the Park festival at Century School Park.
On October 3, officers arrested a 19-year-old Verona man for a stolen firearm offence following a traffic stop for expired registration.
Stop by for the Raspberry Cheesecake flavor of the day, as the store is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM.
